decision_required_from_human: Option A: keep the frozen 1e-06 tolerance and accept that the FedAvg half of the matched pair cannot complete at 50 clients per round in float32.

evidence: The failing tensor is the candidate-head embedding. T1 never reads the candidate axis (candidate_mask is all zeros), so it receives no gradient and all 50 clients return it unchanged. Its exact weighted average is therefore the input tensor itself, and any nonzero difference is arithmetic noise.
The project oracle weighted_average_state_dicts accumulates in float64 and casts back to float32, so it is an effectively exact reference.
Flower 1.33 aggregate_arrayrecords accumulates in float32: it computes value.numpy() * (w / total_weight) and adds in place across all 50 replies.

Replaying that exact algorithm offline on this parameter with the real round-1 weights (50 clients, weights 1..134, total 1530) reproduces a max_abs_diff of 9.54e-07 against the float64 reference, the same order as the observed failure.
The parameter's largest absolute value is 3.3645, so one float32 rounding is already 4.0e-07, and the loose bound n*eps*|x|max over 50 additions is 2.0e-05.
diagnosis.implication: At 50 clients per round and float32 aggregation, the declared atol of 1e-06 sits below the arithmetic noise floor of the operation it checks. A correct FedAvg implementation cannot be expected to pass it at this scale. The tolerance was calibrated on earlier smaller-scale smokes.
